mapper.select: /*상권 추천 리스트 API (초기투자금 필터 필요*/ SELECT AD.DISTRICT_CODE, AD.DISTRICT_NAME, AAD.ADMIN_DONG_CODE, AAD.ADMIN_DONG_NAME, AD.LONGITUDE, AD.LATITUDE, S.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE, S.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE_NAME FROM AREA_ADMIN_DONG AAD LEFT OUTER JOIN AREA_DISTRICT AD ON LEFT(CAST(AAD.ADMIN_DONG_CODE AS CHAR), 5) = CAST(AD.DISTRICT_CODE AS CHAR) LEFT OUTER JOIN STORE S ON S.ADMIN_DONG_CODE = AAD.ADMIN_DONG_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SERVICE_CATEGORY SC ON SC.SERVICE_CATEGORY_NAME = S.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE_NAME WHERE SC.MAIN_CATEGORY_CODE = #{mainCategoryCode} AND S.SERVICE_INDUSTRY_CODE_NAME = #{serviceIndustryCodeName};
